arguments.command:
cd /tmp && python3 -c "
import parse

# Test full string matching expectations
tests = [
    ('{:d}', '42', True),
    ('{:d}', '42\n', True),
    ('{:d}', '42 extra', False),  # Should this fail?
    ('{:d}', 'extra 42', False),
    ('hello {:d}!', 'hello 42!', True),
    ('hello {:d}!', 'hello 42! extra', False),
]

for fmt, val, expected in tests:
    r = parse.parse(fmt, val)
    status = 'OK' if (r is not None) == expected else 'UNEXPECTED'
    print(f'{status}: parse({fmt!r}, {val!r}) = {r}')
"
